sentences.en: Curse on all laws but those which love has made!
sentences.zh: 但愿所有法律都该遭诅咒，除了爱情所创造的！

sentences.en: An experienced healer can lift curses and dispel evil eyes.
sentences.zh: 一位有经验的治疗师可以解除诅咒和驱除邪眼。

sentences.en: Don't curse or I'll wash your mouth out with soap.
sentences.zh: 不许骂人，否则我要用肥皂给你洗嘴。

phrases.zh: 诅咒黑暗不如点亮蜡烛

senses.zh: 诅咒，咒骂，天谴，祸端，行经
